details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- prompts/mode-plan-acceptance.txt:30-31 (and byte-identical prompts/_templates/mode-plan-acceptance.txt:30-31) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new bullet "- A workflow-heal plan whose `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL: REPRODUCIBLE:` line names the reproducing tests may leave these lines out." tells the planner to write a heal value that the current heal gate rejects. scripts/partial_delivery.py:59 HEAL_CF_VALUE_RE accepts only PASS|PARTIAL|FAIL|UNVERIFIED, and scripts/partial_delivery.py:254-256 returns reason=malformed_line for anything else. scripts/acceptance_check.py:191-205 treats the same line as a valid heal result.
  WHY: With PERSIST_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED=true and HEAL_ROUTE=true, a heal plan that follows the bullet is held for human approval as malformed_line, and the two consumers of the same line disagree. This contradicts docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:384, "Without #8409 P2, heals follow the normal contract". All five reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:610 (no hunk) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds tests/test_acceptance_check.py but no workflow step names it. ci.yml:610 runs only tests/test_attempt_journal.py.
  WHY: static-checks on head bd922898 already fails with "AssertionError: These test files run in no workflow ... tests/test_acceptance_check.py", so CI stays red and none of the P2 contract tests run. The reviewer rated it BLOCKER, and the other four reviewers raised the same defect as a task gap.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:594-605 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: acceptance_check.py and targeted_file_context.py are added to the required staging loop, which exits 1 at lines 599-601 ("::error::Missing required support script ${f}") when a file is missing, whatever PERSIST_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED says.
  WHY: In a ref-skew window where SCRIPT_REF and the main snapshot both lack the helpers, the plan job fails with the switch off. That breaks "with the variable off nothing changes", whereas the prompt fragment at plan.yml:770-783 is staged as optional. Severities disagree: minimax MAJOR, sonnet NIT, glm NIT. The highest is used.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2160-2173 ("Validate done-check (acceptance)" step, marker redirect) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The step writes straight to acceptance_marker.txt, so an interrupted or failed write can leave a partial or corrupted marker file.
  WHY: The orchestrator tick might read a stale or partial marker as valid and wrongly pass the done-check. Sonnet and minimax raised the same issue only as hardening suggestions (write to a tmp file, then mv).
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:427-431 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: marker_line() escapes only `<`, `>` and `&`, not `--` or `-->`. A `-->` inside a test path, check name, job name or post-merge reason may close the host HTML comment early, which contradicts the comment at line 429.
  WHY: GitHub's renderer would truncate the marker and leak trailing JSON into the rendered comment. The repo escapes `-->` elsewhere (scripts/attempt_journal.py:261, scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:87), and parse_marker's greedy `.*` still recovers the raw line. Sonnet disputes the finding: marker_line replaces every ">" with "\u003e", so "-->" becomes "--\u003e", and test_marker_exact_bytes_and_escaping covers this case.
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:339-342 (_check_matches; _scan_jobs / _yaml_jobs) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Check names containing `${{` are filtered out of the workflow's `names` set, so a templated check such as `Build ${{ matrix.os }}` is always rejected as `unknown_check:<name>`.
  WHY: The error is a false positive with no helpful message, though the field is deliberately restricted.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2160-2173 (continue-on-error plus `|| true`) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The validate step sets `continue-on-error: true` and also appends `|| true` to the python invocation, which is redundant and silently swallows real helper failures.
  WHY: An uncaught exception produces no marker and no journal record of the broken path, so regressions never surface.
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:374-388, 401-403 (validate() post-merge count; marker size guard) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The marker-size guard overwrites `errors` with `["marker_too_large"]`, which discards earlier errors such as `too_many_tests` and `post_merge_count:<k>`.
  WHY: scripts/attempt_journal.py:481 acceptance_fields records errors verbatim, so the operator loses the reasons the plan was rejected.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:770-783 (prompt staging block) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The prompt fragment is staged as optional while the helpers are required. In a ref-skew window the helper is staged without the fragment, and the planner writes nothing parseable.
  WHY: The reviewer says the diff introduces no new runtime failure (the outcome is state=none, the documented off behaviour) and flags it only as a stale-failure window.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6153-6163 (PR body done-check block) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `parse` succeeds but `render` returns empty, no warning is emitted, and the PR body silently drops the done-check section. `::warning::Could not render the done-check section` fires only on a python exit != 0.
  WHY: Operators cannot see why the section is missing. This is an observability gap, not a correctness defect.
- scripts/attempt_journal.py:700-706 (build_parser() append `--acceptance-file`) | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A new `--acceptance-file` flag sits beside `--gate-result`, and acceptance_fields sits beside gate_fields.
  WHY: The reviewer states "It does not" fail: nothing is renamed, and the default `{"state": "none", "unmet": []}` is preserved, so there is no contract break.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Pair workflow/script changes with the contract tests the plan calls for" and "The P2 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, a pytest step naming tests/test_acceptance_check.py next to the tests/test_attempt_journal.py step at ci.yml:603-610
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR has no ci.yml hunk, and no workflow references test_acceptance_check. tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:25 UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST is empty. The static-checks run on head bd922898 (job 124248113362) fails tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py::test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow with "These test files run in no workflow ... tests/test_acceptance_check.py". The PR body lists this failure under "Failures caused by this change". ci.yml is outside the issue's files_touched grant, and the conflict must be resolved in favour of wiring the test. Adding the file to UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST is not a fix.
- requirement: Every new tracked-surface file (prompts/mode-plan-acceptance.txt, scripts/acceptance_check.py) gets a docs/INVENTORY.md roster entry. tests/inventory_exemptions.txt says it is "Intentionally empty; add entries only when a documented parity escape is required."
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md (a Phase-prompts entry beside prompts/mode-plan-heal-counterfactual.txt at docs/INVENTORY.md:29, and a Scripts entry), plus removal of tests/inventory_exemptions.txt:3-4
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR has no docs/INVENTORY.md hunk. The two exemption lines at tests/inventory_exemptions.txt:3-4 call themselves temporary ("issue #8427 P2 scope grant excludes docs/INVENTORY.md; add the roster entry there and drop this line"), which makes them a scope-grant workaround rather than a documented parity escape. tests/inventory_parity.py:16,169-183,261-263 enforces the pairing. docs/INVENTORY.md is also missing from the files_touched grant.
- requirement: Plan P2 item 4: "plan.yml: a new step after 'Parse planning output' ... Size: at most 1 KB" (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:382)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The plan.yml hunks (env default at lines 21-22, prompt-staging block at 770-784, validate step at 2160-2173, Post-step marker line at 2772-2774, acceptance_args block at 2811-2814) total about 1.2-2 KB. No comment explains the overrun. tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py timed out on head bd922898, but glm notes that plan.yml (~3630 lines) is far below the 480,000-byte guard.
- requirement: "implement.yml: in the PR-body compose step, after the gate summary, append acceptance_check.py render output when a marker exists. Size: at most 0.5 KB."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/implement.yml, PR-body compose step
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The block added at lines 6154-6163 does the rendering but is larger than the 512-byte limit.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (no hunk), checked by tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py::test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow; ci.yml:610 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds tests/test_acceptance_check.py and never wires it into CI.
  WHY: static-checks on head bd922898 fails with "AssertionError: These test files run in no workflow ... tests/test_acceptance_check.py". The fix is one pytest line after ci.yml:610, not an UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST entry. ci.yml is outside the files_touched grant.
- prompts/mode-plan-acceptance.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-plan-acceptance.txt:30-31 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The REPRODUCIBLE heal bullet conflicts with prompts/mode-plan-heal-counterfactual.txt:25-28, 50 and partial_delivery.HEAL_CF_VALUE_RE (scripts/partial_delivery.py:59), which returns reason="malformed_line" (partial_delivery.py:254-256).
  WHY: Heal plans are held for a human and the done-check comes out as state none, so turning the switch on changes heal approval. This contradicts docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:384. Fix: delete the bullet from both copies and keep the inert _heal_reproducible_ids parser.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:594 (exit at 599-601) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The helpers are required-staged whatever PERSIST_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED says. The prompt fragment is optional (plan.yml:770-783), and P1 used the same required pattern for attempt_journal.py.
  WHY: In a narrow ref-skew window the plan job exits 1 with the switch off.
- Note: rejected minimax's marker_line() `-->` claim. ">" becomes "\u003e", so "-->" is emitted as "--\u003e", and test_marker_exact_bytes_and_escaping covers the case.
- Note (checked and found fine): parse_marker trailer at index 0; implement.yml staging (implement.yml:1478, 1829-1831); stdlib-only imports; "invalid" state accepted (attempt_journal.py:76, ACCEPTANCE_STATES); all new execution is gated, with defaults of 'false' (implement.yml:2590-2613 trusted-author filter, sanitize_item, auto-close lint).
